headline: Dairy plant collapses after 81 years. More than 100 people will lose their jobs. "The industry will shrink"
summary: The Cuiavia dairy in Inowrocław is being liquidated, with 112 jobs lost. The process runs to June 2027, with about 50 positions cut first.
why: Dairy processors link farm milk supply with retail and export markets, so plant closures can signal sector consolidation in regional food production.
original_headline: Upadek mleczarni po 81 latach. Pracę straci ponad 100 osób. "Branża będzie się kurczyć"
